title: Page 193
transc:
Beckwith #2  Washn Oct 4th 1864
Topsy Molasses sulphur Baker to Lantern tulip I've just 
returned from with in Andrew Sylvans of Carroll stop
There arno widow there orin that vicinity Their making
no preparations to patron in this direction There arno
wedge at Charity orrits approach = cheese this side except 
at Cherry a portion of Wayne saddling a warwicking
Pauline for disabled silvers a Provost saddle corn stripping
& a few corn strips yard Hurley hasbeen united
by about Dayton zebra summer sent pack with Kettle
who rank to take princeton shylock wrangle also Trades
quaker and Rossers Palmetto of Pedlar such are the
current watsons below windham HM Lazelle Paxton &c


Beckwith No 2  Washn Oct 4th 1864 
Henrietta Young for Shark Rufus In galls or Pearl
PP Pitkin tulip Please send here immy all
the waltzers that can possibly be spared from your
place They are needed at once Answer & give
the names of those you send wiley Rucker Palermo 


JW Sampson Balto No 1 Washn Oct 4th 1864
Henrietta Tuesday for Pandora Newport unity
Please send here immy all the
spark weaselers that can possibly be
spared from your place They needed
at once Answer & give the 
names of those you send DH Rucker 
Q Mr
